text:
Maya (Partnerships): quick sync — we need a crisp handoff + announce timeline for the SI + hardware partner co-sell + marketplace listing. who owns the SFDC mapping?
Ethan S.: I can own the SFDC schema. propose adding fields: SI_Assigned, HW_Partner, Marketplace_Source, CoSell_Status. small change.
Liz - Sales Eng: for field rules: SI gets first touch on any inbound from their joint channel for 30 days. if no activity, it reverts to RD.
Dom K.: +1. also need 'net-new' definition. is a marketplace lead considered net-new if account not in SFDC?
Maya (Partnerships): yes — marketplace leads count as net-new. we should mark them with Marketplace_Source=AWS/Azure/GCP.
GTM Ops: timeline question — PR/announce window needs 4 weeks for legal+marketing. do we have asset owners?
Maya (Partnerships): marketing will own the public asset pack, HW partner marketing will supply logos + talking points. SI to supply joint case study outline if available.
Ethan S.: from ops side, SFDC rule pseudo:
```
if (Lead.Source == 'Marketplace') { Lead.Owner = SI_Assigned; Lead.Lock = true for 30d; }
else if (Lead.Source == 'Partner_Web' && SI_Assigned) { route to SI }
```
Liz - Sales Eng: handoff play: SI qualifies -> demo -> MQL. After MQL, AE + SI run joint demo. AE owns contract. SI owns implementation scope.
Dom K.: escalation path: if AE thinks SI isn't engaging in 10 business days, escalate to Partnerships@redwood and cc SI Partner PM.
GTM Ops: milestone calendar suggestion: Week 0: partner sign-off on announce; Week 1: asset finalization; Week 2: internal enablement + sales cheat sheet; Week 3: soft marketplace listing; Week 4: public announce + joint webinar.
Maya (Partnerships): okay let's lock that. action items: Ethan -> add SFDC fields & automation by EOD Fri; Liz -> create one-pager for AE + SI playbook by Tue; Dom -> confirm escalation contacts from SI; GTM Ops -> draft announce calendar and PR checklist.
Ethan S.: working on SFDC change, will add a validation rule to prevent owner change during lock period.
Liz - Sales Eng: I'll stub the one-pager in Confluence and ping here when ready.
Dom K.: pinged SI PM (cc'd) to confirm their contact list. they said they'll provide two leads: PM and Technical Lead.
PartnerBot: Reminder: new partnership intake form submitted: "HWCo - Edge Appliance".
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. last thought — measurement: we'll tag opportunities with CoSell_Status = {prospecting, engaged, demoed, closed}. report weekly.
GTM Ops: noted, will add dashboard card for CoSell_Status and Marketplace_Source breakdown.
Ethan S.: any objections to 30d SI lock?
Liz - Sales Eng: sounds fine. maybe extend to 45d for large-enterprise accounts (>$250k).
Dom K.: agree on extension for >$250k. add threshold in SFDC rule.
Maya (Partnerships): consensus. I'm going to merge this into a short SOP and share with SI + HW partner. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
